units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:5">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ח׳ אנא</he> I am an ass-driver.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>פלן ח׳ יצלי</he> let that certain ass-driver pray. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>חמר עבין ההוא גוברא וכ׳</he>, read: <he>חמש עבירן וכ׳</he>, v. margin ed. Krot.]—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:1:3">Y. Snh. VI, beg. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>הא שאלתא דח׳</he> in that form it would be an ass-driver’s question.—Pl. <he>חַמָּרַיָּיא</he>. Y. Taan. IV, 67ᶜ bot.
